::: {#def-temperature}

#### Temperature

Sampling at **temperature** $T > 0$ draws the next symbol from the [softmax](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/multiclass-logistic-regression.html#def-softmax) of $\vecf{z} / T$,
where $\vecf{z}$ is the vector of the model's [logits](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-logits)
[@hinton2015distilling].
At $T = 1$ this is the model's own distribution.
As $T$ falls toward 0 the distribution puts more of its weight on the most likely symbols,
and as $T$ grows it approaches the uniform distribution.

:::
